rules.statement: The commitment and contract period is one calendar year and automatically extends unless deregistered.

result.description: 1 January to 31 December; automatic continuation.

rules.statement: At least 1.50 ha arable land must be managed in each participation year.

result.description: Minimum participation condition met.

rules.statement: If the 1.50 ha minimum is not reached, the measure contract expires and a new timely measure application is required for later participation.

result.description: New timely application required for a later re-entry.

rules.statement: The obligations apply to all arable land, while premium is granted on all managed arable land.

conditions.description: Arable parcel of the participating holding.

result.description: Include the parcel in the measure assessment.

rules.statement: Main and intercrops are cover crops; a parcel without one counts as covered only while the maximum permitted intervals are met; fallow land counts as covered.

result.description: Determine cover status from crop status and permitted interval.

rules.statement: An intercrop is a crop actively established after a main crop and followed by an actively established main crop; sowing or undersowing is active establishment and undersowing is dated to main-crop harvest.

result.description: Only actively established qualifying crops are intercrops.

rules.statement: Volunteer growth, cereal, maize, and mixtures with more than 50% cereal and/or maize are not intercrops, except green-manure rye varieties under seed law.

conditions.description: Crop components and their shares are known.

result.description: Treat the period as uncovered unless another qualifying crop applies.

rules.statement: At least 85% of arable area must have full cover with main or intercrops at every point in the entire year.

conditions.description: The annual minimum of point-in-time covered arable area.

result.description: Annual full-cover threshold is met.

rules.statement: The interval from main-crop harvest to intercrop establishment may be at most 30 calendar days.

result.description: The parcel continues to count as covered.

rules.statement: The interval from intercrop termination to main-crop establishment may be at most 30 calendar days.

result.description: The parcel continues to count as covered.

rules.statement: The interval from main-crop harvest to main-crop establishment may be at most 50 calendar days.

result.description: The parcel continues to count as covered.

rules.statement: Establishment day is covered; main-crop harvest and arable-fodder or intercrop termination days are uncovered. For staggered harvest, the last subarea harvest starts the calculation.

result.description: Calculate each uncovered interval with the specified inclusions.

rules.statement: On NAT land prescribed to self-cover after tillage, a valid main crop exists only if full regreening occurs within 50 days; otherwise the period until full regreening is uncovered.

conditions.description: A NAT project confirmation prescribes tillage without reseeding.

result.description: Apply 50-day full-regreening test.

rules.statement: Uncovered or uncultivated land added after 15 October is excluded from the 15% limit if it would otherwise make compliance impossible; it must comply once cropped in the following year.

conditions.description: Arable land was added after 15 October.

result.description: Temporary exclusion only for the stated accession situation.

rules.statement: A fully covering intercrop must be actively established by 15 October at the latest.

result.description: Latest establishment deadline met.

rules.statement: An intercrop established by 20 September needs at least three mixture partners from two plant families; proof of seed may be required when partners are not visible in the field.

result.description: Early intercrop composition is compliant.

rules.statement: An intercrop established after 20 September must be exclusively winter hardy; from application year 2025, less than 50% frost-sensitive components may be admixed, and it may be terminated no earlier than 15 February following year.

result.description: Late intercrop conditions met.

rules.statement: Every intercrop must remain at least 42 days; renewal after 42 days through 15 October is permitted only immediately and if the replacement lasts another 42 days.

result.description: The intercrop counts toward cover.

rules.statement: Mineral nitrogen is prohibited on all intercrop land from establishment through the NAPV closed period in the following year, including combined fertilisation at sowing.

result.description: No mineral-N application in the prohibited interval.

rules.statement: Plant-protection products, including slug pellets, are prohibited from intercrop establishment until termination; if termination is not mechanical, use is only allowed after sowing the successor crop.

result.description: No prohibited plant-protection use.

rules.statement: Active tillage that kills plants and knife rollers are prohibited during intercrop cover; strip-till preparation or deep loosening is allowed only with substantial preservation of cover, and care operations retain or restore full cover.

result.description: Only allowed soil cultivation and care were used.

rules.statement: Chopping, mowing without removal and rolling on winter-persistent intercrops are allowed only after 31 October; early non-ground chopping for listed problem weeds requires retained/restored full cover and retained evidence.

conditions.description: Operation date, method, weed basis and evidence.

result.description: Seasonal care restrictions are met.

rules.statement: Mowing with removal or grazing is allowed without threshing only if full cover remains and can regrow; ground-level harvest without regrowth begins an uncovered period.

result.description: Permitted intercrop use.

rules.statement: Intercrops must be mechanically removed; eligible methods include listed tillage equipment after cover, ground-level chopping after frost, direct/mulch/strip-till sowing of successor crop, or fully frost-killed/rolled exclusively frost-sensitive components.

result.description: Compliant intercrop termination.

rules.statement: Continuous parcel-specific records for main-crop harvest, intercrop establishment/termination and successor main-crop establishment must cover all arable land from 1 January through 31 December.

conditions.description: Records are continuous and include required events for all arable parcels.

result.description: Recordkeeping obligation fulfilled.

rules.statement: The measure must be requested in the multi-application by 31 December before contract start; final entry is funding year 2027 through application by 31 December 2026.

result.description: Timely application; no first entry after 2027.

rules.statement: All main crops including second crops are declared in the multi-application; System-Immergrün intercrops may not be declared there, and a declared winter-hardy cover is treated as main crop.

conditions.description: All main and second crops declared.

result.description: Crop declarations use the required distinction.

rules.statement: Simultaneous holding participation in System Immergrün and Begrünung von Ackerflächen – Zwischenfruchtanbau is not allowed.

result.description: Incompatible scheme not selected.

rules.statement: Winter-persistent System-Immergrün intercrops may support Erosionsschutz Acker using mulch sowing, direct sowing or strip-till; after deregistration, those methods cannot participate there in the following year.

result.description: Subject to Erosionsschutz Acker requirements.

rules.statement: Exit is possible after fulfilling the annual contract and must be reported online; deregistration during 1 January–31 December makes the measure invalid for that funding year.

conditions.description: Exit after the year whose obligations are fulfilled.

result.description: Annual obligations were not invalidated.

rules.statement: The annual premium band for arable land is EUR 70.0 to EUR 90.0 per hectare; the minimum is guaranteed and actual rate depends on requested area and available funds.

result.description: Apply annual rate within the stated band.

rules.statement: Conditionality applies; payment reductions for substantive breaches are assessed by severity, extent, duration and frequency on a measure basis, from warning/2% through exclusion and recovery after two 100% reductions.

conditions.description: A breach is detected and assessed by AMA.

result.description: Apply the stated reduction scale and recovery consequence.

rules.statement: For 2026, no objection is made where a proper cover establishment was performed but drought prevented full cover or caused volunteer cereal to exceed 50%; no notification is required and the case is automatically higher force.

result.description: No report required for the stated establishment failure.

rules.statement: For 2026, the 30-day intercrop or 50-day main-crop latest planting interval may be exceeded when prospective management is credibly shown and soil, phytosanitary or cropping conditions preclude planting; sow at the earliest possible time in 2026. The 20 September/15 October deadlines, 42 days and other conditions remain.

result.description: Only the 30/50-day interval is relaxed.
